help.angelaSub: Southampton pubs and bars take part in the Ask for Angela scheme. If you feel uncomfortable, unsafe, or just want to leave quietly, walk up to any member of bar staff and ask for "Angela". They'll discreetly help you slip away, call a taxi, or stay with you until you're sorted. No questions, no fuss.
help.angelaTitle: In any pub or bar, ask for "Angela"
help.buddySub: In a group? Text or AirDrop the app link to anyone in your party. Once they open it, they'll see the same tours, the same stops, and the same way back. If you get separated, agree to meet at the next Loop on the trail.
help.call101: Hampshire and Isle of Wight Constabulary, non emergency.
help.duskSub: Above Bar Street and the High Street stay lit and busy until late. After sunset, we'd suggest heading back through WestQuay's main concourse rather than along Western Esplanade.
help.duskTitle: After dark, stick to the busy streets
help.lostSub: Licensed black taxis queue at the WestQuay south entrance and beside the Civic Centre. Your cruise line keeps a port agent on duty all day at the terminal. Their number is in your daily programme, worth a photo on your phone before you set off.
help.spotsSub: Staffed venues where someone can help, lend a phone, or just give you a glass of water.
help.sub: Southampton's a welcoming city. If you need a hand, here's how to find it.
help.title: You're never far from someone friendly.
